title: Alter database charset lead to cpu high load
review_reason: 20,000-table ALTER DATABASE performance experiment requires 2 GiB buffer pool plus overhead, high open-file/table-cache limits, repeated timings and profiling. Current 2 GiB container/20-second SQL budget cannot match this. CPU use alone is not correctness oracle; hardware and improvement baseline remain unanswered in c539106.
